meta.title: Supporters’ association
meta.description: The supporters’ association (Förderverein) of TG MIPA Landshut: together for handball in Landshut.

hero.title: Supporters’ association
hero.subtitle: Stronger together, for handball in Landshut.

intro.title: Become part of the Förderverein
intro.text: The Förderverein of TG MIPA Landshut supports our teams and enables children and young people to play handball. Every membership helps keep the sport alive in our city.

community.title: Community
community.text: As a member of the Förderverein you are part of a strong community that supports handball in Landshut.

support.title: Support
support.text: Your membership enables young players to take part in club sport.

success.title: Success
success.text: Together we promote top performance and strengthen Landshut as a handball location for the long term.

signup.title: Become a member now
signup.text: Fill in the form and give us a SEPA direct debit mandate for the annual fee.

fee.text: The annual fee is {fee} and is collected once a year by SEPA direct debit.

mandate.text: I authorise {name} to collect payments from my account by SEPA Core direct debit. At the same time, I instruct my bank to honour the direct debits drawn on my account by {name}. Note: I can request a refund of the amount debited within eight weeks, starting from the date of debit. The terms agreed with my bank apply. The mandate reference will be sent to me separately.

consent.mandate: I give the SEPA direct debit mandate for the annual membership fee. *
consent.privacy: I have read the <link>privacy policy</link> and agree to my data being processed. *
